tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background, the Timeline's well.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels: the Timeline rows and the side picker.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised parts inside a panel: a picker option, a sheet, a menu.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Hover and selected rows; the active level row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only, never a control's sole edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of controls and inputs; at least 3:1 on surface-100 and surface-200.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and option names on every ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: levels, sources, Refusal detail. Reads on every ground and surface.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: hints, counts, keyboard keys. On ground, surface-100 and surface-200 only.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: The accent: wardstone brass. Primary buttons, the selected pick, focus of the eye. Text-safe on every surface.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a gold fill.

tokens.name: mythic
tokens.usage: Mythic ranks and Mythic picks only: the rank marker, Mythic class names.

tokens.name: open
tokens.usage: Status: an open option. Always with its check mark and the word Open.

tokens.name: closed
tokens.usage: Status: a closed option and its Refusal. Always with its cross mark; never the only signal.

tokens.name: gear
tokens.usage: Status: a gear-dependent pick (ADR 0002), with the items it needs.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, offset 2px. At least 3:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The Build's name and the page title. Once per screen.

styles.name: rank
styles.usage: The Mythic rank marker in the Timeline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Needs Power Attack, which you take at level 3.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Slot names and section labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Ability scores, BAB, saves: anything that lines up in columns.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its word; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; padding inside a picker option row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of a Timeline row and a picker option.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; the page's side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panels and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a page title.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, picker options.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the phone picker sheet.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Only on what floats over the page: the phone picker sheet, the Cascade preview, menus.
